Consensus

AI search engine for scientific research. Find consensus across millions of peer-reviewed papers.

Key features of Consensus

  • Scientific search
  • Evidence-based
  • Consensus meter
  • Paper summaries
  • Free tier

Pricing: Free / $8.99/mo. Plans change often, so check the official site for the latest details. Our editorial rating is 4.5 out of 5.
